verdict.rationale: iTerm2's shell integration is documented as command-aware: it knows where prompts are and what commands you enter, keeps per-host command history, sets marks at each prompt, and loads automatically from profile settings. Separately, the app offers job-completion notifications, but the evidence does not tie them to shell integration. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-command exit status display, command duration tracking, notifications specifically for long-running commands tied to shell integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
